notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
Aura of Dominion attached to Xavier Sal.
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Devoted Druid and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Devoted Druid, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the creature token, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.
